name: 06451 · Meriden, CT
findings: ZIP 06451 (Meriden) has 62 nonprofit organizations. 27 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 23 organizations.
Youth organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 06451 (Meriden) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
